name.value: Prestige Rocky Mountain Resort Best Western Premier Collection

description.value: The Prestige Rocky Mountain Resort is a full-service 111-room hotel in Cranbrook offering a range of room types including kitchenette suites and the novelty of sleeping in a repurposed train car. The property features two on-site restaurants (Fire and Oak and BRIXX Brewhouse), a spa, indoor pool, hot tub, and athletic centre. Positioned just off the main highway, it serves as a well-appointed base for cyclists exploring the East Kootenay region.
